resources.string: Example plugin for atak-reactive: a React UI in a WebView panel, wired to ATAK\'s map engine through the typed JavaScript bridge. Demonstrates markers, shapes, routes, GPS, CoT, and the perf harness.\n\nDISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A. Approved for public release: distribution unlimited.
